preconditions.expression: T == int(T) and T > 0 and T <= 500000
preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases, bounded by 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(N == int(N) and N > 0 and N <= 100000 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: Each N is a positive integer representing the size of the permutation, bounded by 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and all(1 <= int(x) <= N for x in A) and len(set(A)) == N for A, N in zip([line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]], [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
preconditions.description: Each permutation A is a list of N distinct integers from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_line.split()) == N for stdout_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= N for x in stdout_line.split()) for stdout_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains integers from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(stdout_line.split())) == N for stdout_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a permutation of integers from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(stdout_line.split()[i]) <= int(best_line.split()[i]) for i in range(N)) for stdout_line, best_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [min([line.split() for line in possible_perms]) for possible_perms in possible_perms_list], [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
postconditions.description: Each output line is lexicographically smallest possible permutation achievable by applying at most two swaps and any number of left shifts to the input permutation. Here, possible_perms_list is the set of all permutations achievable by at most two swaps and any number of left shifts.
